methodologicalAnalogy.name: Code-QA-Bench
methodologicalAnalogy.relationship: Methodological analogy only; its repository-access conditions and LLM judging protocol are not reproduced by this browser benchmark.

trackStatus: retired-disclosed after publication of final-state evidence and expected-answer hashes; use a new held-out track for future blind evaluation
selection: Filter to non-stochastic operation_code tasks whose declared start page exists and whose pinned text assets contain no external HTTP(S) or protocol-relative URL literal, then for each of the 21 domain-by-level strata choose the task with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of selectionSeed + ':' + task id. The exact IDs and asset inventory totals are frozen in track.json.
scoring: Exact case-sensitive operation-code match after Unicode NFKC normalization and removal of outer whitespace only.
assetIntegrity: Every cached regular Git file is checked by byte size and Git blob SHA-1; every LFS file is checked by byte size and raw SHA-256, using metadata from the pinned Hugging Face tree API.

protocol.externalLiteralScanScope: HTTP(S) and protocol-relative URL literals in pinned CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, SVG, text, and XML assets
protocol.runnerNavigationRule: Remain on the printed task-specific origin; top-level external navigation is prohibited by protocol and is not claimed to be fully enforced by CSP
